# docsrs-cli
> One-shot stdin/stdout CLI for crates.io and docs.rs documentation for LLM agents.

docsrs-cli is a born-execute-finalize-die binary that searches crates, fetches README overviews and typed rustdoc items, and emits stable JSON envelopes on stdout with diagnostics only on stderr. Current release line is 0.1.x with ranked `--match` modes, effective-URL `--page-token` echo, method-scoped `extraction`, non-retryable `kind=budget`, cascade `--suggest`, hyphen path normalize, rustdoc chrome scrub, doctor `ok` parity, timeout-0 fail-closed, and `data.cache_hit`.

## Optional
- [get-item schema](docs/schemas/get-item.schema.json): item_name, resolved_version, extraction, cache_hit
- [search-in-crate schema](docs/schemas/search-in-crate.schema.json): match_mode, score, cache_hit
- [search-crates schema](docs/schemas/search-crates.schema.json): page tokens, effective echo, cache_hit
- [readme schema](docs/schemas/readme.schema.json): resolved_version and cache_hit
- [schema meta](docs/schemas/schema.schema.json): embedded schema document payload
- [completions schema](docs/schemas/completions.schema.json): shell + script JSON mode
- [error schema](docs/schemas/error.schema.json): budget kind, retryable flag, top-level error envelope
- [dry-run schema](docs/schemas/dry-run.schema.json): planned_url and planned_params.crate_name
